source: Ed4 K.3.2.1 and K.3.2.2, pp.K-8 to K-9
description: A node with nothing queued starts in SENSE with no timer and stays there through bursts, received bytes and external busy changes, producing no output.
note: Construction is START (core-architecture.md section 10 item 1). The received bytes hold no 90 EB sync. csma.mode is left null: a node with nothing queued never contends, so it never needs it.
